prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent hero cutout for a jewellery website design study
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and the sole factual reference.
Primary request: Remove the entire background and isolate only the two visible hands, their visible attached wrist/forearm portions, and every ring worn on them.
Composition/framing: preserve the original positions, scale, overlap, crop, hand gestures, and landscape canvas proportions exactly. The forearms may continue naturally to the existing top edge exactly as in the source; do not invent or extend missing anatomy.
Style/medium: preserve the source photograph and its black-and-white photographic treatment.
Constraints: genuine transparent background with clean alpha edges. Preserve the hands' identity, anatomy, fingers, nails, skin texture, lighting, focus, and every ring exactly. Preserve all gaps between fingers as transparency where the original background shows through. Change only the background.
Avoid: no new hands, fingers, jewellery, skin, sleeves, shadows, floor, backdrop, halo, outline, retouching, recoloring, smoothing, crop changes, text, logo, or watermark.
